key.name: retention-days
key.description: Number of days to keep usage data. 0 means keep forever.

key.name: max-interval
key.description: Maximum interval between focus events before capping to prevent skewed data after suspend.

key.name: purge-requested
key.description: Internal, not user-facing. Set by the prefs UI to a unix timestamp to request an immediate one-time deletion of usage data older than 7 days.

key.name: show-total-in-panel
key.summary: Show today's total in the panel
key.description: When enabled the panel shows the icon plus today's total screen time; when disabled only the icon is shown.

key.name: app-limits
key.description: Maps an application id to a daily limit in minutes. When today's tracked time for that app reaches its limit, a one-time notification is shown for the rest of the day.
